name: Camping 101: Alchemy
summary: At your camp, alchemists can learn to craft a Mana Well. Carolai Anise in Brill teaches the craft once you have shown skill in alchemy.

sections.title: A camp for brews
sections.body: Carolai Anise in Brill teaches alchemists to craft a Mana Well for their camp. Once you know the craft, you can make camp in the wilderness. First, you need a campfire, which cooks can teach you to make.

faq.q: Who teaches me to craft a Mana Well?
faq.answer: Carolai Anise in Brill can teach you to craft a Mana Well once you have shown skill in alchemy.

faq.q: What is a Mana Well for?
faq.answer: A Mana Well is a camping item you can craft as an alchemist. Healers and spellcasters are drawn to its refreshing taste.

faq.q: Where can I learn the Mana Well craft?
faq.answer: Carolai Anise in Brill can teach you the Mana Well craft.

faq.q: What do I need before starting a camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire before you start your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make one.
